categories.name: High and Often
categories.score: highest number rolled x number of times it was rolled

categories.name: Only two numbers
categories.criteria: The six rolls are all one of two numbers (e.g. 3-6-3-6-6-6)

categories.name: Ordered subset of four
categories.criteria: In roll order, 4 adjacent rolls that step by +1 each (1-2-3-4) or by -1 each (5-4-3-2)
